description.value: Bar Bravo is a MICHELIN Guide Recommended seafood restaurant in Vancouver's Fraserhood neighbourhood, opened in August 2023 and awarded Vancouver Magazine's Best New Restaurant 2024. The small, intimate space features an open kitchen and an evolving seasonal menu of raw and cooked dishes with bold, globally inspired flavours. A touring cyclist stopping in would find a thoughtful bar program and creative cocktails alongside standout plates like Tofino King Salmon and house-shucked oysters.
